# Dubai Property Expo 2026

> The official portal for the Dubai Property Expo 2026 hosted by The Real Estate Mall on September 19th & 20th, 2026[cite: 8].

The Dubai Property Expo 2026 brings together 40+ top UAE developers and 200+ luxury residential and commercial projects under one roof across Baner and Kharadi hubs[cite: 8]. It offers attendees exclusive benefits like flexible post-handover payment plans, spot booking discounts, 0% tax investment opportunities, zero brokerage, and on-site Golden Visa assistance[cite: 8].

## Core Details
- [Event Overview & VIP Registration](https://www.dubaipropertiesexpo.in/#register): Claim free VIP entry passes, select budget preferences, and reserve event seats[cite: 8].
- [Expo Hubs & Locations](https://www.dubaipropertiesexpo.in/#hubs): Venue details for Baner Road (West Pune) and Kharadi IT Hub (East Pune)[cite: 8].
- [Why Attend](https://www.dubaipropertiesexpo.in/#why-attend): Overview of flexible payment options, Golden Visa benefits, tax-free returns, and complete legal support[cite: 8].

## Event Specifications
- **Dates:** September 19th & 20th, 2026 (10:00 AM – 8:00 PM)[cite: 8]
- **Organized By:** The Real Estate Mall (MahaRERA Reg No: A041262500652)[cite: 8]
- **Property Price Range:** ₹1.80 Crores to ₹26.10 Crores+ (AED 750K to AED 50M+)[cite: 8]
- **Venues:** 
  - *Baner Hub:* 2/2 Achalare House, Baner Road, Pune 411069[cite: 8]
  - *Kharadi Hub:* Nyati Plaza, Thite Nagar, Kharadi, Pune 411014[cite: 8]
